The gaps were clarity, not capability: a greyed DONE that did not say why outside beginner/standard mode, a confirm button labelled with a cancel glyph, melds packed into the top-left of an empty table, a menu backdrop that read as a debug overlay, a 14-row flat settings list with COPY TEST LOG in it, and a rotate banner that told every phone player portrait was wrong.
shipped: DONE clarity: '✕ FEITO' prefix removed; the blocking reason is now live in every helper mode; beginner adds a three-line ✓/✕ checklist derived from canConfirmTurn's own result
state-aware objective copy: start / card-selected / played-tap-DONE / table-invalid / ready-to-confirm (src/core/objective.ts)
table layout: meld rows centred horizontally, block centred vertically when it fits (src/table/layout.ts)

improvement_package.auditSummary: Most of the requested package already shipped: helper modes, invalid-meld badges, legal-target glow, live FEITO/DONE reasons with a beginner checklist, table legality signalling, mobile tap-first and the Mexe editor, ready check and host start, endgame result copy, pt-BR/en-US parity. selectedSlices: settings schema: aiDifficulty / aiSpeed / aiExplain / timerTickSound, each with a per-field sanitizer fallback
settings UI: an AI sub-panel (SettingsRow.Ai) plus a timer-tick row under AUDIO
ai.ts: Difficulty as a search tier orthogonal to personality; 'smart' reproduces the shipped behaviour exactly

server: per-room settings, host-only lobby edit, freeze at startGame, turn clock as data checked by the 1s tick, timerExpireTurn wired
anti-stall: per-seat missedTurns, missedTurnLimit ends the match, reconnect resumes the running clock
client: lobby room summary with host preset cycling, in-match countdown with a warning colour and tick cue, timeout notices
rules panel: the online timer and the AI settings explained in both locales (rules.uiHelp)

fixed a pre-existing verification bug: the `help`/`help-en` captures clicked a drifted pause-menu row and photographed the settings panel, so the rules panel had no screenshot; the captures now click REGRAS and assert debugApi.rulesOpen
improvement_package.fairnessBoundary: Room settings (timer mode, turn length, Mexe bonus, warning, reconnect grace, missed-turn limit) are fairness-affecting: host-only, lobby-only, frozen at startGame, and normalized server-side so no client value is ever applied verbatim. Personal settings (helper mode, AI difficulty/pace/explanation, audio, accessibility, cosmetics) are local presentation or local-play only and may change at any time; none of them touch an online match.
invariantsHeld: core rules unchanged — rules.ts untouched except that timerExpireTurn now has a caller
a timeout can only ever produce draw-one-and-pass on the server's turn-start table; no illegal confirm is reachable
the client renders turnMsLeft and cannot start, pause, extend or expire a turn
turnMsLeft is outside the state digest, so a running clock never reads as a desync
AI is blind to hidden hands at every difficulty and every candidate still passes canConfirm
